items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
items.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

items.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
items.summary: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

items.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
items.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

items.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
items.summary: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.

items.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.

items.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
items.summary: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

items.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
items.summary: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

items.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
items.summary: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
items.summary: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.
